announcements.title: A Quick Note from the Aniraku Team
announcements.banner: Thank you for your continued love and support for Aniraku.
body:
Hey everyone… 👋

Aniraku is still just a passion project I keep running between real life, caffeine, and the occasional existential crisis. Your support is literally what keeps the lights on (and me from deleting the whole repo at 3 a.m.).

We’re now on V5.8.10.2. Proper in-app offline downloads are finally here — no external downloader required. After a download finishes you might need to go back and then return to the downloads page, or just reopen the app, for the file to show up. Yeah… that little quirk is still living its best life. Working on it.

Please fully uninstall the old V5.7.9 before installing the latest V5.8.10.1 so nothing breaks in mysterious ways.

Also… I’m still looking for a couple of kind souls to help me grow a proper Discord and Telegram community. I’m not exactly a natural community manager (more like the quiet guy who just wants everyone to watch anime in peace), so any help setting things up the right way would mean a lot.

I’d love to hear from you. Is there anything else you need? Any feature that would make your day? Bugs? Missing titles? Random thoughts? Just mail me. I’m honestly a little sad that almost nobody has said much about the app so far… I keep checking my inbox like a protagonist waiting for that one important letter that never comes. Don’t leave me hanging, okay?

If you enjoy Aniraku and want to help keep this little project alive, a small donation would mean the world (and a few extra coffees for those late-night fix sessions).

Missing an anime, facing an error, or just want to say hi? Email me anytime.

Thanks for sticking with Aniraku. Now go enjoy some anime… and maybe reply to this lonely developer once in a while.

— the guy who still hasn’t slept enough
